# ONYX Club

ONYX Club is a sport, lifestyle and wellbeing club in Cologny, Geneva, Switzerland, near Lake Geneva. The club's website is bilingual in French and English.

- Official website: https://onyxclub.ch/
- French homepage: https://onyxclub.ch/fr/
- English homepage: https://onyxclub.ch/en/
- Activities: https://onyxclub.ch/fr/activites/ (individual activity pages are available in French and English)
- Group class timetable and prices: https://onyxclub.ch/fr/tarifs/
- Team: https://onyxclub.ch/fr/equipe/
- Frequently asked questions: https://onyxclub.ch/fr/faq/
- Contact and location: https://onyxclub.ch/fr/contact/

The club lists yoga, combat sports, private training, running, personal development, bootcamp, Strong Nation / Circle Mobility, and stretching. Group classes are CHF 40 per class and private sessions are listed from CHF 120 per hour; confirm current availability and prices with the club.

Address: Chemin du Nant-d'Argent 1, Cologny, Geneva, Switzerland.
Phone: +41 78 613 70 21.
Email: contact@onyxclub.ch.
